hero.title: HAPA NDIPO SAUTI, UJUZI, NA CONFIDENCE YA UBUNIFU HUJENGWA.
hero.subtitle: Rekodi vocals, tengeneza music, jenga podcasts, na jifunze ala ndani ya studio environment iliyoundwa kwa creators.

zones.title: Studio lanes tano zimepangwa kama chumba kimoja cha production kinachofanya kazi.
zones.body: Kila zone imejengwa ihisi ya vitendo na media-first, ikiwa na labels wazi, session energy ya kweli, na nafasi ya creators kujifunza kwa kufanya.

recordingStudio.label: Tracking Room
recordingStudio.title: Recording Studio
recordingStudio.description: Chumba chenye focus kwa vocals, demo takes, guided recording, na repeat sessions zinazomsaidia creator kuzoea mic.

musicProduction.label: Production Desk
musicProduction.title: Music Production
musicProduction.description: Jenga beats, shape arrangements, na sogeza rough ideas kuwa drafts zilizo imara zaidi kwa studio guidance na workflow safi.

podcastSetup.label: Voice Booth
podcastSetup.title: Podcast Setup
podcastSetup.description: Unda spoken-word sessions, interviews, na voice-led content ndani ya setup inayoweka mazungumzo yakiwa wazi na controlled.

instrumentTraining.label: Practice Corner
instrumentTraining.title: Instrument Training
instrumentTraining.description: Hands-on practice ya piano, guitar, drums, na vocals iliyoundwa kujenga rhythm, confidence, na repetition ndani ya studio.

creativePracticeSessions.label: Creator Lab
creativePracticeSessions.title: Creative Practice Sessions
creativePracticeSessions.description: Nafasi pana kwa creators kujaribu ideas, kurehearse, kurudia, na kuzoea tools na pace ya sessions za kweli.

path.title: Session log inayotoka kwenye first sound hadi output iliyokamilika.
path.body: Path hii inatakiwa ihisi kama production board, si classroom outline. Inamfanya creator asonge kupitia tools, practice, na recorded work akiwa na momentum.

steps.title: Pick Your Sound
steps.description: Chagua ala, sauti, au format unayotaka kuunda na funga creative direction mapema.

steps.title: Learn the Tools
steps.description: Zoea studio tools, session flow, na practical habits zinazofanya creation iwe rahisi.

steps.title: Practice in Session
steps.description: Rudia sehemu muhimu, jenga control, na jifunze kupitia active sessions badala ya theory ya mbali.

steps.title: Record / Produce
steps.description: Ingia kwenye takes, drafts, beats, edits, au voice capture mara tu creative direction inapoanza kujisikia tayari.

steps.title: Package Your Output
steps.description: Shape matokeo yawe kitu kinachoweza kushare-iwa, kureview-iwa, au kuwa tayari kwa hatua inayofuata ya ubunifu.

atmosphere.title: Microphones, instruments, desks, na creator energy vikikaa ndani ya chumba kimoja.
atmosphere.body: Atmosphere inabaki broad na honest: hands-on practice, recording focus, na studio setup inayowasaidia creators kuzoea production spaces za kweli.

cta.title: INGIA NDANI YA STUDIO NA UJENGE SAUTI YAKO.
cta.subtitle: Anza na session yenye focus, uliza kuhusu training, au fungua mazungumzo ya moja kwa moja kwenye WhatsApp na tutakuongoza kwenye hatua inayofuata.
